control.description-key: PBS Hub Ops Console SL-1 and SL-2: credit score of every host per band, the ledger of one host, adding a reward or penalty from a rule, and voiding a transaction with a reversal row.

property.name: Context
property.description-key: JSON {userEmail,userName,roles,permissions,config}. config: scoreInitial, scoreMin, scoreMax (ScoreConfig), optional bigPenaltyPoints (default 10) and scheduleMinScore.

property.name: HostsJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Host - PBS Hub]: ID, Title, HostCode, NamaHost, Status, Package, InitialScore, CurrentScore, MinimumScore, MaximumScore, optional LedgerScore. Never send KTP, NoRekening, Alamat, PhoneNumber or PersonalEmail.

property.name: ScoreTxJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [FAS STUDIO] HostScoreTransactions of the recent weeks for every host (HostID, TransactionID, Reason, Point, Status, CreatedDate): the Transaksi terakhir column.

property.name: LedgerJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [FAS STUDIO] HostScoreTransactions of HostId, all of them: ID, TransactionID, RuleID, TransactionType, Point, ScoreBefore, ScoreAfter, Reason, Notes, Status, CreatedDate, CreatedBy.

property.name: RulesJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of the score rules: RuleID, RuleName, RuleType, Point, Category, Severity, Description, Active. Only active rules are offered.

property.name: ThresholdsJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [FAS STUDIO] HostScoreThreshold: ThresholdID, Label, Description, MinimumScore, MaximumScore, Tone, Active, SortOrder.

property.name: HostId
property.description-key: Host.Title whose ledger is shown. Empty: the host list.

property.name: HasMore
property.description-key: true when the server has more hosts than were sent: shows Muat lebih banyak (LOAD_MORE).

property.name: IsLoading
property.description-key: true while canvas is loading: renders skeleton rows.

property.name: ReferenceDate
property.description-key: Optional ISO date-time used as now (testing).

property.name: ActionResult
property.description-key: Canvas reply {requestId,status,message}. ADD_SCORE and VOID_SCORE lock until it comes back.

property.name: ActionPayload
property.description-key: JSON {action,requestId,payload}: OPEN_LEDGER, BACK, ADD_SCORE, VOID_SCORE, FILTER_CHANGED, LOAD_MORE, NAV.
